props.title: Clockwise

sections.content: Clockwise stands as one of John Cleese's finest post-Monty Python performances, masterfully channeling his talent for controlled chaos into the role of Brian Stimpson, an obsessively punctual headmaster. The film brilliantly builds tension through escalating mishaps, similar to Martin Scorsese's After Hours (1985) but with a distinctly British flavor. Like Planes, Trains and Automobiles (1987), it transforms a simple journey into an anxiety-fueled odyssey, mining humor from a rigid character's desperate attempts to maintain order in an increasingly disordered world.

sections.content: The film's brilliant use of time as both plot device and metaphor influenced later British comedies like Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994) and About Time (2013). Director Christopher Morahan employs precise timing in both physical comedy and dialogue, creating a masterclass in comedic escalation. The script by Michael Frayn (who wrote the equally precise farce Noises Off) demonstrates how structure can enhance rather than constrain comedy.

What sets Clockwise apart is its exploration of the particularly British relationship with time and propriety. While American films like Falling Down (1993) approach similar themes of control versus chaos through violence, Clockwise maintains a lighter touch while still delivering sharp social commentary. Cleese's Stimpson represents the last gasp of post-war British rigidity colliding with a more casual modern world. SUBHEAD: The Art of the Controlled Breakdown

movies.slug: A theatrical farce about a theater company putting on a farce, with precision timing and escalating chaos

sections.content: The film's influence can be seen in later works like One Fine Day (1996) and Run Lola Run (1998), where time pressure drives both narrative and character development. Cleese's performance inspired a whole generation of comedy actors in portraying the "dignity in distress" character type, visible in Hugh Grant's various fumbling protagonists and Steve Carell's work in Date Night (2010).
